video_title: Toronto Raptors Full Media Availability | Post Game vs Memphis Grizzlies | November 09, 2026

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic on the team's transition scoring and offensive rebounding
quotes.excerpt: I think it was a little bit more than four box score, I don't know if I really always trust
quotes.quote: I think it was a little bit more than four box score, I don't know if I really always trust the box score. I'm not joking, I'm serious about this because a lot of times when you look at the box score it's 16 or 18 points, but the way we look in house and how transition is creating, I think it was a little bit more than that but definitely not as much as we used to get in transition. I think our big emphasis tonight, because they're the number one crashing team in the league, big emphasis was we have to finish possessions, which is not easy. They got 13 offensive rebounds, we did get 15 against them, so that might be the reason why we're not running even more.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic on the Raptors transition struggles against Memphis: I do not always trust the box score, but our transition scoring is definitely not where it used to be.

structured.context: Darko Rajakovic discusses the team's transition scoring and offensive rebounding performance against the Memphis Grizzlies.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic on RJ Barrett's playmaking and handling defensive attention
quotes.excerpt: whatever defense throws at him, he's always trying to find the best options, best solutions
quotes.quote: Whatever defense throws at him, he's always trying to find the best options, best solutions. quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic on the team's resilience and lack of excuses

quotes.quote: I'm learning that this group is never looking for excuses, doesn't matter who's playing or not playing for us. None of us are looking for the excuses, we are always looking for what's ahead of us and we accept the challenge and they're looking forward for that challenge.

quotes.summary_phrase: Jakob Poeltl on his offensive role during short-handed games
quotes.excerpt: I feel like it's it's just depends like on on who's who's out there for us
quotes.quote: I feel like it's it's just depends like on on who's who's out there for us, like what our offensive game plan looks like. In some of these games lately, especially like the last one and this one, we just don't have as many like creators out there. So I feel like I have to do a little bit more.
